caseNameFull: Biggs, Administratrix v. Missouri Pacific R. Co. and Graves v. Same
attorneys: Mr. G. T. Fitzhugh for petitioners. Messrs. Edward. J. White and Thomas B. Pryor for respondents.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The appeals herein are dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. Section 238, Judicial Code as amended by the Act of February 13, 1925 (43 Stat. 936, 938), U. S. Code, Title 28, § 345; § 13, Act of February 13, 1925 (43 Stat. 936, 941).
